title: Component
description: One software component at one version: a package, a library in a closure, or an operating-system package. Matching uses `purl` first and `cpe` second. It maps to a CycloneDX component.

version.description: The version as the ecosystem writes it. Absent when no version is known.

ecosystem.description: The OSV ecosystem name (for example `npm`, `PyPI`, `Maven`, `Go`, `crates.io`), or the purl type when no OSV ecosystem applies.

cpe.description: The CPE 2.3 formatted string, or a CPE 2.2 URI.

patches.description: The patches that the build applies to the upstream source, by name. An empty list means no patches. Absent means that the patches are not known.

artifact.description: The artifact that contains the component: a Nix store path, an OCI image digest, or the digest of a host package list.

storePath.description: The Nix store path of the component, when it has one.

foundIn.description: Where the inventory found the component, for example the closure, a lockfile or the host package database.

paths.description: The manifests and lockfiles that declare the component, relative to the repository root.

direct.description: True for a direct dependency and false for a transitive one. Absent when the dependency graph is not known.
